candidates.description: Current specialist for long automation workflows with many repetitive terminal/tool steps and large context, especially balanced cost with sustained execution. Not the first choice for the hardest architecture or formal proofs.
candidates.evidence: MiniMax M3 official report describes 1M context, coding and long tool-driven workflows; publishes coding/agentic evaluations with methodology. Claims are manufacturer-reported.

candidates.evidence: Moonshot K3 technical blog reports visual/agentic coding, long-context and frontend capabilities; vendor benchmarks are not a universal ranking.
